scope: 48 proposed locale pairs, 96 messages, excluding all 11 manifest-blocked locales and all 81 unscoped picker tags.
review_type: Independent model-assisted whole-message semantic/grammar review, with targeted primary dictionary/vendor evidence. Not native-speaker or comprehensive language certification.
semantic_baseline: Raster compositing combines source/background pixels according to their transparency. Do not replace this with changing opacity, removing a channel, or SVG-to-PNG rasterization. A transparency-based local paraphrase is permitted.
evidence_limits: All 96 strings were read against the exact source; linguistic assessments are model judgements. No native speakers were consulted.
Technical documentation establishes the intended computation, not the fluency of every translation.
Dictionary constituent support and project terminology consistency do not establish whole-message idiomaticity.
Seven revisions improve explicitness; they are not seven proven defects. A failed or empty terminology search is not evidence that a term is invalid.
No production catalogue, manifest, source message, key, or blocked-locale status was edited.
No Android compilation, CI, font, bidirectional display, vertical-layout, or on-device test was performed in this review.

gimp-compositing.supports: Technical meaning: pixels from layers and their backgrounds are combined using alpha values; not a statement about deleting a channel.
gimp-compositing.does_not_establish: Fluency or the preferred translation in any target language.

imagemagick-compositing.supports: Technical meaning: pixel opacity affects each pixel color’s contribution when composited.
imagemagick-compositing.does_not_establish: The project’s implementation or target-language terminology.

revo-komponi.supports: komponi includes artistic composition and putting constituents together; kunmeti is used in the explanation.
revo-komponi.does_not_establish: That alfa-komponado is wrong, or that the proposed full Esperanto clause is externally approved.

eki-transparency.supports: The literal see-through meaning and inflected forms of läbipaistvus, including läbipaistvust.
eki-transparency.does_not_establish: An established Estonian alpha-compositing term or the whole proposed sentence.

gimp-fi-layers.supports: Finnish image-combining vocabulary and explanations of transparency and colors being combined with lower layers.
gimp-fi-layers.does_not_establish: An attested term alfakoostaminen; the glossary examined separately largely falls back to English.

microsoft-id-alpha.supports: Indonesian vendor explanation connects transparency components and alpha blending; uses transparansi and perpaduan alfa.
microsoft-id-alpha.does_not_establish: Native-speaker verification or endorsement of the proposed penggabungan phrase.

dbp-gubahan.does_not_establish: A specialized Malay compositing standard. The direct compositing lookup was inaccessible.

microsoft-ms-transparency.supports: Malay ketelusan is used for a widget whose transparency reveals the game behind it.
microsoft-ms-transparency.does_not_establish: The complete proposed Malay raster clause or any preferred alpha-compositing name.

mongol-supply.supports: нийлүүлэлт is a result noun with supply-related examples; this explains possible ambiguity in the tentative phrase.
mongol-supply.does_not_establish: That нийлүүлэлт can never mean combination.

mongol-combine.supports: нэгтгэх has the sense of making separate things one.
mongol-combine.does_not_establish: A conventional graphics term or full-sentence acceptance.

mongol-transparent.supports: тунгалаг has a literal see-through/clear sense.

adobe-vi-vocabulary.supports: Adobe’s Vietnamese navigation uses ghép ảnh and độ trong suốt in image-editing contexts.
adobe-vi-vocabulary.does_not_establish: An exact alpha-compositing equivalent. This is constituent vocabulary evidence only.

taiwanese-transparent.supports: MOE gives 透明 as Tâi-lô thàu-bîng; the project’s POJ thàu-bêng is an editorial orthographic conversion.
taiwanese-transparent.does_not_establish: Verbatim MOE endorsement of POJ or the whole technical phrase.

taiwanese-combine.supports: Education Cloud’s MOE Taiwanese entry gives 合成 as Tâi-lô ha̍p-sîng, corresponding to project POJ ha̍p-sêng.

taiwanese-degree.supports: 度 tōo includes degree or extent; POJ tō͘ preserves that reading.
taiwanese-degree.does_not_establish: An attested whole entry for 透明度 in the proposed clause.

cantonese-according.supports: 按 on3 in 按照 has the according-to sense.

cantonese-transparent.supports: 透明度 is tau3 ming4 dou6 and has a literal transparency sense.

cantonese-combine.supports: 合成 is hap6 sing4 and can describe combining media, including images.

gimp-ru-compositing.supports: Russian explanation distinguishes blending from compositing and describes combining with regard to each pixel’s transparency.
gimp-ru-compositing.does_not_establish: That only one Russian term is acceptable; no replacement is required solely because GIMP uses совмещение.
